ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 15:85 ratio of high-intensity (white/light gray) to low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity contiguous region across central fluke. High-contrast light-intensity mottling and focal spots concentrated along the lower trailing edge of the left lobe and the distal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with a wide angle; partially obscured by foreground bird occlusion but maintaining structural continuity.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire continuous linear boundary, most pronounced on the lateral thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the median notch toward the distal tips; lobes terminate in acute, tapered points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of localized, circular high-contrast white clusters located primarily on the right lobe tip and scattered along the left lobe trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular protrusion and textured massing on the far-right lobe tip, consistent with significant biological colonization or structural trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Numerous high-intensity foreground occlusions resulting from multiple avian subjects (birds) in flight across the fluke's visual field.
